cipher.name: VowelConsonantAlternatingShift
cipher.idea: A simple, highly structured substitution cipher designed to be extremely easy for LLMs to compute without errors. Vowels (A, E, I, O, U) are shifted forward by 1 position in the vowel sequence (A->E, E->I, I->O, O->U, U->A). Consonants are shifted forward by 1 position in the alphabet, skipping vowels (e.g., B->C, C->D, D->F, Z->B). Case is preserved, and non-alphabetic characters (digits, spaces, punctuation) remain completely unchanged.
cipher.encrypt_rules:
For each character in the text:
1. If it is a vowel (A, E, I, O, U, case-insensitive), shift it to the next vowel in the sequence: A->E, E->I, I->O, O->U, U->A. Maintain the original casing.
2. If it is a consonant, shift it to the next consonant in the alphabetical order (skipping vowels): B->C, C->D, D->F, F->G, G->H, H->J, J->K, K->L, L->M, M->N, N->P, P->Q, Q->R, R->S, S->T, T->V, V->W, W->X, X->Y, Y->Z, Z->B. Maintain the original casing.
3. If it is a digit, space, punctuation, or any other symbol, leave it completely unchanged.
cipher.decrypt_rules:
For each character in the text:
1. If it is a vowel (A, E, I, O, U, case-insensitive), shift it to the previous vowel in the sequence: E->A, I->E, O->I, U->O, A->U. Maintain the original casing.
2. If it is a consonant, shift it to the previous consonant in the alphabetical order (skipping vowels): C->B, D->C, F->D, G->F, H->G, J->H, K->J, L->K, M->L, N->M, P->N, Q->P, R->Q, S->R, T->S, V->T, W->V, X->W, Y->X, Z->Y, B->Z. Maintain the original casing.
3. If it is a digit, space, punctuation, or any other symbol, leave it completely unchanged.
